errors.evidence: The chart title only shows the acronym "HCI". The full name "индекс за граждани на ЕС" (EU citizens index) is an interpretation and not present in the figure's text.
The x-axis labels are 2012, 2014, 2016, 2018, 2020, which are at 2-year intervals, not 1-year intervals.

errors.text_span: Оста Y е обозначена с „Стойности на HCI”
errors.evidence: The y-axis has no label. "Стойности на HCI за България" is the title of the chart.

errors.text_span: Диапазонът на стойностите е от 0,76 до 0,86.
errors.evidence: The y-axis range shown in the figure starts at 0.75, not 0.76.
In 2016, the line reaches its lowest point (a trough), not a peak ("връх").
The value in 2016 is the minimum, at approximately 0.79, not 0.84.
The line does not gradually decrease. It decreases from 2012 to 2016, and then increases from 2016 to 2020.
The value in 2020 is approximately 0.84, not 0.79.
